# @cortex-ui/source-manager-settings-share

Settings > Share: send picked changes to the CortexCode project as a pull request, after a privacy check.

- **Plugin id:** `source-manager.settings-share`
- **Slot:** `settings.share@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `settings.share@1` as `source-manager.settings-share`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** none
- **Workbench state written:** `settings.open`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `frame.plugins.list`, `source.diff`, `source.share.candidates`, `source.share.send`, `source.share.status`, `vcs.github.status`
- **Topics followed:** `plugin.unit`, `source.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
